title: The Invisible Triangle
subtitle: A Murder Mystery Wrapped in Deception
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi and his companion find themselves entangled in the recounting of an unsolved murder, the lines between storyteller and investigator blur. With a clever policeman seeking their help and no evidence but plenty of intrigue, Byomkesh must devise a plan to catch a killer hiding in plain sight. Step into a tale where every conversation could be a clue and nothing is quite as it seems.
